name: AnchorNav
label: Anchor nav
description: An on-page list of anchor links that tracks the reader's position, listed by hand or read from the page's headings.

props.name: items
props.description: The on-page sections to list, in document order. Leave it out and pass `fromHeadings` to read them from the page.

props.name: fromHeadings
props.description:
Read the sections from the page's headings instead of listing them:
`{}` lists every `h2` in `main`, and `root`, `selector` and `minItems`
narrow it. Ignored when `items` is passed. Renders nothing until enough
sections are found.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual form: `list` renders the inline "On this page" rail; `floating` collapses to a stack of short lines that expands into a panel on hover, keyboard focus, or tap, so it can ride a page edge without taking column width

props.name: title
props.description:
Header text above the list; pass an empty string to render no header.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which AnchorNav does not expose.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon beside the header — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode); pass an empty string for none

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled active item id — set it to drive the highlight yourself and skip scroll tracking

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the tracked (or clicked) active item changes

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance in px from the viewport top at which a section counts as current, e.g. a sticky header's height. A heading with a larger `scroll-margin-top` counts from there, so a jump to it always marks it.

AnchorNavHeadingSource.description: Where `fromHeadings` (and `useHeadingItems`) look for the page's sections.
